skin.en: Hmm, I think clay can be used to smooth the skin on people’s faces.
skin.zh: 嗯，我想粘土可以用来让人脸上的皮肤变得光滑。

skin.en: It was like having my skin ripped off of me at that moment.
skin.zh: 那一刻就像是活生生把我的皮给剥了下来。

skin.en: Is clay good for: a) curing headaches? b) digesting food? or, c) smoothing face skin?
skin.zh: 粘土有何妙用：a) 治疗头痛？b) 消化食物？还是 c) 平滑面部皮肤？

skin.en: So, Neil, itching is our skin's way of protecting itself against harmful parasites.
skin.zh: 所以，Neil，痒其实是皮肤用来抵御有害寄生虫的一种自我保护方式。

skin.en: Sonja Ständer It sounds like hairy skin so I would go for the scalp.
skin.zh: Sonja Ständer：听起来像是毛茸茸的皮肤，所以我会选头皮。

skill.en: Clear pronunciation is a skill that most people improve through listening and practicing sounds.
skill.zh: 清晰的发音是一种技能，大多数人通过聆听和练习发音来提升它。

skill.en: When you combine talent with advantage and especially skill, it makes up your overall ability.
skill.zh: 当你把天赋与优势、尤其是技能结合起来时，它就构成了你的整体能力。

skill.en: Prioritizing skills and employment is practical and measurable, but this approach also creates tension.
skill.zh: 优先考虑技能和就业是务实且可衡量的，但这种方法也带来了紧张局势。

skill.en: Ability is your actual skill level. Confidence is your belief in your ability.
skill.zh: 能力是你实际的技能水平。自信则是你对自身能力的信念。

skill.en: Schools and universities all have a role to play in teaching these skills.
skill.zh: 学校和大学在教授这些技能方面都扮演着重要角色。

skip.en: Skipping grades might have made academic sense, but socially it was a disaster.
skip.zh: 跳级在学业上可能合乎情理，但在社交上却是一场灾难。

skip.en: Now, you will forgive me if I skip forward by a couple of centuries here.
skip.zh: 请原谅我在这里跳过几个世纪。

skip.en: Luckily for him, and for our story, he managed to escape from jail, and skipped town.
skip.zh: 幸运的是——对他本人，也对我们这个故事来说——他成功越狱并逃离了小镇。

skip.en: How about you? Well, I could never skip, so I think I just preferred playing football.
skip.zh: 你呢？好吧，我从来不会跳绳，所以我想我更喜欢踢足球。

skip.en: If you skip a meal, it means that you don't eat it.
skip.zh: 如果你skip一顿饭，意思就是你没吃它。

skim.en: Or you can learn to speed read or skim read.
skim.zh: 或者你可以学会速读或略读。

skim.en: To state the obvious, we have only scratched the surface on the life of this man; hundreds of thousands of pages have been written, and I hope you will forgive me for skimming over many important and fascinating elements.
skim.zh: 显而易见，我们只是触及了这个人一生的冰山一角；相关文字记录多达几十万页，希望大家原谅我略过了许多重要且引人入胜的细节。

skim.en: If you want to sit down and read a classic English novel like Pride and Prejudice, and enjoy the experience of reading this great work of literature, the ability to speed read and skim read texts looking for important information isn’t really helpful.
skim.zh: 如果你想坐下来读一本经典的英文小说，比如《傲慢与偏见》，并享受阅读这部伟大文学作品的体验，那种寻找重要信息的速读和略读能力其实并没有什么帮助。

skim.en: So, I don't know if this is strictly true, but theoretically as long as you have a good practice of hygiene - which is to say that you always skim it, and boil it every day, and also replenish it as needed with more water, more salt, more spices, and you know, you keep tasting - then it just gets richer and richer.
skim.zh: 所以，我不知道这是否严格意义上的真实，但理论上，只要你保持良好的卫生习惯——也就是说你总是撇去浮沫，每天煮沸，并根据需要补充更多的水、更多的盐、更多的香料，你知道的，不断品尝——那么它就会变得越来越浓郁。

skim.en: This might start with something as basic as skimming over a Wikipedia entry to try to get an overview of the topic, before going into more detail about particular events or parts of the story, reading opinion pieces, downloading datasets and trying to make sense of them, reading books on the topic, it can be anything that helps me understand the topic better.
skim.zh: 这可能从最基础的浏览维基百科词条开始，以获取主题概览，然后深入研究特定事件或故事片段，阅读评论文章，下载并分析数据集，阅读相关书籍，只要能帮我更好地理解主题，什么都可以。

skeptical.en: I grew up very religious, but very skeptical of religion or anything really.
skeptical.zh: 我成长过程中非常虔诚，但对宗教或任何事情都非常怀疑。

skeptical.en: At first, Hardy was skeptical. He thought the letter might be a joke or a mistake.
skeptical.zh: 起初，Hardy持怀疑态度。他认为这封信可能是一个玩笑或是一个错误。

skeptical.en: Now, when the FBI received the tip, they were initially skeptical.
skeptical.zh: 现在，当 FBI 收到这条线索时，他们起初是持怀疑态度的。

skeptical.en: You want to be an optimist, but I would say you want to be skeptical about specific things.
skeptical.zh: 你想成为乐观主义者，但我会说你想对具体的事情保持怀疑。

skeptical.en: So even with science, you have to be skeptical.
skeptical.zh: 所以即使面对科学，你也必须保持怀疑态度。

skilled.en: Some of my friends, who are highly skilled, have amazing jobs in the USA.
skilled.zh: 我的一些朋友技能娴熟，在美国拥有令人惊艳的工作。

skilled.en: Now that list is much shorter. Many medium skilled roles have been removed from eligibility.
skilled.zh: 现在这个名单短得多了。许多中等技能的职位已被取消资格。

skilled.en: The UK only wants you to stay if you are highly skilled and highly employable.
skilled.zh: 英国只希望你留下来，前提是你高度熟练且具备很强的就业能力。

skilled.en: On the other, you had the Church demanding skilled administrators and legal experts.
skilled.zh: 另一方面，你有要求熟练的行政人员和法律专家的教会。

skilled.en: But I’m not that technically skilled. I haven’t passed the highest level of the Japanese proficiency test.
skilled.zh: 但我的技术并不那么熟练。我没有通过日语能力测试的最高级别。

skyscraper.en: There are skyscrapers, busy shopping streets, trendy cafés, and a growing economy.
skyscraper.zh: 那里有摩天大楼、繁忙的商业街、时尚的咖啡馆，经济也在不断增长。

skyscraper.en: Aztec ruins lie beneath skyscrapers. Colonial churches stand beside contemporary museums.
skyscraper.zh: 阿兹特克人的废墟静静躺在摩天大楼下方。殖民时期的教堂与当代博物馆比邻而立。

skyscraper.en: There are cafes and museums, tall skyscrapers.
skyscraper.zh: 那里有咖啡馆、博物馆和高耸的摩天大楼。

skyscraper.en: New skyscrapers are alongside ancient churches and mosques, and the city is still seen as the bridge or connection between Europe and Asia.
skyscraper.zh: 崭新的摩天大楼与古老的教堂和清真寺并存，这座城市仍然被视为欧洲与亚洲之间的桥梁或纽带。

skyscraper.en: When I think of the USA, I picture New York’s skyscrapers, Hollywood movies, and Silicon Valley technology companies.
skyscraper.zh: 当我想到美国时，我的脑海中会浮现出纽约的摩天大楼、好莱坞电影以及硅谷的技术公司。

sketch.en: Before he began painting, Leonardo would create detailed sketches and studies.
sketch.zh: 在开始作画之前，列奥纳多会创作详细的草图和研究。

sketch.en: For example, he sketched things that resembled helicopters and parachutes.
sketch.zh: 例如，他画了一些类似于直升机和降落伞的东西。

skillful.en: Talent does not mean you’re going to be skillful or successful.
skillful.zh: 天赋并不意味着你一定会变得熟练或成功。

skillful.en: How skillful were they at regulating their emotions?
skillful.zh: 他们在调节自己情绪方面，又有多熟练？

ski.en: Winter sports are also not cheap. It requires ski passes and lessons and equipment.
ski.zh: 冬季运动也不便宜。它需要滑雪通行证、课程和装备。

ski.en: And they came from families in which their parents and their siblings also skied and snowboarded.
ski.zh: 而且他们出身于父母和兄弟姐妹也滑雪和玩单板滑雪的家庭。
